learn.rule: A joining word shows how two ideas connect: time (when, after, before, while, until), reason (because, since), contrast (although), or condition (if, unless). When the sentence starts with the joining word, put a comma after the first part.
learn.ruleEs: Una palabra de unión muestra cómo se conectan dos ideas: tiempo (when, after, before, while, until), razón (because, since), contraste (although) o condición (if, unless). Si la oración empieza con la palabra de unión, pon una coma después de la primera parte.
learn.model: Although the desert receives little rain, many plants survive there.
learn.notice: Although starts the sentence and shows a contrast. Notice the comma after the first part.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows time.
parts: the air cools below its dew point.
items.model: Water vapor condenses into droplets when the air cools below its dew point.
items.why: When tells the time the condensing happens: at the moment the air cools enough. Although and unless would change the meaning.
items.whyEs: When dice el momento en que ocurre la condensación: cuando el aire se enfría lo suficiente. Although y unless cambiarían el significado.

items.prompt: What does although tell the reader in the sentence about the experiment?
items.text: Although the experiment failed twice, the team kept testing.

options.text: a time
a contrast
a condition

items.why: Although shows a surprise: failing twice might make people stop, but the team kept going. That is a contrast.
items.whyEs: Although muestra una sorpresa: fallar dos veces podría hacer que se detuvieran, pero el equipo siguió. Eso es un contraste.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows a condition.
parts: the temperature rises above 0 degrees Celsius.
items.model: Ice will not melt unless the temperature rises above 0 degrees Celsius.
items.why: Unless sets a condition: melting happens only if the temperature rises. It means if not.
items.whyEs: Unless establece una condición: el hielo se derrite solo si sube la temperatura. Significa if not.

items.prompt: Which sentence about a storm uses the comma correctly?

options.text: Because the pressure dropped the storm intensified.
Because, the pressure dropped the storm intensified.
Because the pressure dropped, the storm intensified.

items.why: When a sentence starts with a joining word like because, put a comma at the end of that first part, before the main idea.
items.whyEs: Cuando una oración empieza con una palabra de unión como because, pon una coma al final de esa primera parte, antes de la idea principal.

items.prompt: Check every plant sentence where the joining word shows time.

options.text: Plants close their stomata when water is scarce.
Plants close their stomata because water is scarce.
The soil stays moist while the rain continues.
Leaves turn yellow after chlorophyll breaks down.
Seeds sprout although the soil is cold.

items.why: When, while, and after all tell when something happens. Because gives a reason and although shows a contrast.
items.whyEs: When, while y after dicen cuándo ocurre algo. Because da una razón y although muestra un contraste.

items.prompt: Choose the joining words that complete the lab sentence.
parts: the lab report is due Friday, students should finish their data tables
items.model: Because the lab report is due Friday, students should finish their data tables before the weekend begins.
items.why: The first blank gives a reason (because the report is due). The second tells the time deadline (before the weekend). Notice the comma after Friday.
items.whyEs: El primer espacio da una razón (because the report is due). El segundo dice el plazo (before the weekend). Fíjate en la coma después de Friday.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about the water cycle. Use a joining word such as although, because, when, while, or unless.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre el ciclo del agua. Usa una palabra de unión como although, because, when, while o unless.
write.model: Although clouds look light, they can hold hundreds of tons of water.

familyTalk.en: Describe today's weather using although, because, or when. Example: 'Although it is cloudy, ...'
familyTalk.es: Describan el clima de hoy con although, because o when. Ejemplo: 'Although it is cloudy, ...'

teacherTip.en: Put the joining words on a chart sorted by meaning (time, reason, contrast, condition) and add examples from your science unit.
teacherTip.es: Pon las palabras de unión en un cuadro por significado (tiempo, razón, contraste, condición) y agrega ejemplos de tu unidad de ciencias.

sets.title: Why Leaders Met in Philadelphia
sets.titleEs: Por qué los líderes se reunieron en Filadelfia

learn.rule: A joining word shows how two ideas connect: time (when, after, before, while, until), reason (because, since), contrast (although), or condition (if, unless). When the sentence starts with the joining word, put a comma after the first part.
learn.ruleEs: Una palabra de unión muestra cómo se conectan dos ideas: tiempo (when, after, before, while, until), razón (because, since), contraste (although) o condición (if, unless). Si la oración empieza con la palabra de unión, pon una coma después de la primera parte.
learn.model: Since the Articles of Confederation gave Congress little power, delegates met in Philadelphia in 1787.
learn.notice: Since gives the reason, and it starts the sentence, so a comma follows the reason.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows the order of events at the convention.
parts: they signed the Constitution in September 1787.
items.model: Delegates debated for months before they signed the Constitution in September 1787.
items.why: Before tells which event came first: months of debate, then the signing. It shows the order in time.
items.whyEs: Before dice qué evento ocurrió primero: meses de debate y luego la firma. Muestra el orden en el tiempo.

items.prompt: What does since tell the reader in the sentence about the Articles?
items.text: Since the Articles gave Congress little power, leaders wanted a stronger government.

options.text: a condition
a reason
a contrast

items.why: Since explains why leaders wanted change: Congress had little power. That is a reason.
items.whyEs: Since explica por qué los líderes querían un cambio: el Congreso tenía poco poder. Eso es una razón.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that shows what states required.
parts: Some states would not approve the Constitution
a Bill of Rights was promised.
items.model: Some states would not approve the Constitution unless a Bill of Rights was promised.
items.why: Unless sets a condition: the states would agree only if a Bill of Rights was promised.
items.whyEs: Unless establece una condición: los estados aceptarían solo si se prometía una Declaración de Derechos.

items.prompt: Which sentence about the convention is punctuated correctly?

options.text: While delegates argued about representation the summer heat made the debates harder.
While delegates argued about representation, the summer heat made the debates harder.
While, delegates argued about representation the summer heat made the debates harder.

items.why: The sentence begins with While, so a comma goes after the first part, right before the main idea.
items.whyEs: La oración empieza con While, así que va una coma después de la primera parte, justo antes de la idea principal.

items.prompt: Check every sentence where the joining word shows a reason.

options.text: Colonists protested because Parliament taxed them without representation.
Colonists protested until Parliament repealed the Stamp Act.
Since the colonists had no voice in Parliament, they objected to new taxes.
Although the tax was small, colonists objected to it.
Merchants boycotted British goods while the Townshend Acts were in effect.

items.why: Because and since explain why something happened. Until and while tell time, and although shows a contrast.
items.whyEs: Because y since explican por qué ocurrió algo. Until y while dicen el tiempo, y although muestra un contraste.

items.prompt: Choose the joining words that complete the sentence about the printing press.
parts: the printing press spread ideas quickly, rulers tried to control books
items.model: Because the printing press spread ideas quickly, rulers tried to control books before readers could challenge their power.
items.why: The first blank gives the reason rulers worried (because ideas spread fast). The second shows time: they wanted control before readers could challenge them.
items.whyEs: El primer espacio da la razón de la preocupación (because ideas spread fast). El segundo muestra el tiempo: querían control antes de que los lectores los desafiaran.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about an event in history. Use a joining word such as because, although, when, before, or after.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre un hecho de la historia. Usa una palabra de unión como because, although, when, before o after.
write.model: Although the colonists were loyal to Britain at first, many later demanded independence.

familyTalk.en: Tell a story from family or local history with a joining word: 'Before we moved here, ...'
familyTalk.es: Cuenten una historia de la familia o de su comunidad con una palabra de unión: 'Before we moved here, ...'

teacherTip.en: Have students underline the joining word and circle the comma in each sentence from the unit, then explain the relationship it shows.
teacherTip.es: Pide que subrayen la palabra de unión y encierren la coma en cada oración de la unidad, y que expliquen la relación que muestra.

learn.rule: A joining word shows how two ideas connect: time (when, after, before, while, until), reason (because, since), contrast (although), or condition (if, unless). When the sentence starts with the joining word, put a comma after the first part.
learn.ruleEs: Una palabra de unión muestra cómo se conectan dos ideas: tiempo (when, after, before, while, until), razón (because, since), contraste (although) o condición (if, unless). Si la oración empieza con la palabra de unión, pon una coma después de la primera parte.
learn.model: If two ratios simplify to the same fraction, they are equivalent.
learn.notice: If starts the sentence and sets a condition. The comma comes after the condition, before the result.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that completes the fraction rule.
items.model: A fraction is undefined when its denominator is zero.
items.why: When tells the exact situation: at the moment the denominator is zero, the fraction is undefined. Unless would reverse the rule.
items.whyEs: When dice la situación exacta: en el momento en que el denominador es cero, la fracción no está definida. Unless invertiría la regla.

items.prompt: What does unless tell the reader in the sentence about triangles?
items.text: A triangle cannot be built unless the two shorter sides add up to more than the longest side.

options.text: a contrast
a time
a condition

items.why: Unless names the one condition that must be true for a triangle to exist. It means if not.
items.whyEs: Unless nombra la única condición que debe cumplirse para que exista un triángulo. Significa if not.

items.prompt: Choose the joining word that completes the sequence directions.
parts: Starting at 0, keep adding 4 to each term
items.model: Starting at 0, keep adding 4 to each term until the sequence reaches 100.
items.why: Until tells when to stop: the action continues up to the moment the sequence reaches 100.
items.whyEs: Until dice cuándo detenerse: la acción continúa hasta el momento en que la sucesión llega a 100.

items.prompt: Which sentence about a discount is punctuated correctly?

options.text: If the discount is 25 percent the sale price is 75 percent of the original.
If the discount is 25 percent, the sale price, is 75 percent of the original.
If the discount is 25 percent, the sale price is 75 percent of the original.

items.why: The sentence begins with the joining word If, so one comma separates the condition from the result.
items.whyEs: La oración empieza con la palabra de unión If, así que una coma separa la condición del resultado.

items.prompt: Check every math sentence where the joining word shows a condition.

options.text: If a number is divisible by 2 and 3, it is divisible by 6.
Although 0.5 and 1/2 look different, they name the same amount.
A graph is proportional only if it is a straight line through the origin.
Maya checked her work after she solved the equation.
Since two sides are equal, the triangle is isosceles.

items.why: If sets a condition that must be true. Although shows a contrast, after tells time, and since gives a reason.
items.whyEs: If establece una condición que debe cumplirse. Although muestra un contraste, after dice el tiempo y since da una razón.

items.prompt: Choose the joining words that complete the recipe sentence.
parts: the recipe makes only 12 muffins, we can triple it
items.model: Although the recipe makes only 12 muffins, we can triple it if we need 36 muffins.
items.why: Although shows a contrast (only 12, yet we can still make more). If sets the condition for tripling the recipe.
items.whyEs: Although muestra un contraste (solo 12, pero aun así podemos hacer más). If establece la condición para triplicar la receta.

write.prompt: Write one sentence about ratios or fractions. Use a joining word such as if, unless, until, when, or because.
write.promptEs: Escribe una oración sobre razones o fracciones. Usa una palabra de unión como if, unless, until, when o because.
write.model: If a recipe uses a 2 to 3 ratio of flour to milk, then 6 cups of flour need 9 cups of milk.

familyTalk.en: Make a family rule with if or unless: 'We can watch a show if ...'
familyTalk.es: Inventen una regla familiar con if o unless: 'We can watch a show if ...'

teacherTip.en: Ask students to rewrite one of their math rules two ways: once starting with the joining word and once ending with it.
teacherTip.es: Pide que reescriban una de sus reglas de matemáticas de dos maneras: una empezando con la palabra de unión y otra terminando con ella.
